_comment: The input schema Robinhood's place_equity_order actually declared, captured 2026-09-10 via `npm run trade:schema`. Kept verbatim so the payload builder is tested against the real thing rather than a guess.

account_number.description: Brokerage account number. Must be agentic_allowed=true.

dollar_amount.description: USD notional. Only valid with type=market.

limit_price.description: Limit price; required for limit or stop_limit.
